7.4.1.v: A short is substituted for the vowel, standing in a penultimate position, the Causative अङ्ग (stem), when the affix चङ् (sign of the Reduplicate Aorist of the Causatives) follows.

7.4.2.v: The shortening of the penultimate of the stem, before the causative affix in the reduplicated Aorist, does not take place, when it is a (Denominative) अङ्ग (stem), which has lost a simple (end vowel of the Nominal stem) before the Causative sign and also not, when it is the verb शास् , or a root which has an indicatory ऋ।

7.4.3.v: The shortening of the penultimate of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) in the reduplicated Aorist, is optional in the following - 1. भ्राज् 2. भास् 3. भाष् 4. दीप् 5. जीव् 6. मील् and 7. पीड् ।

7.4.4.v: The penultimate vowel in the Causative अङ्ग (stem) पा 'to drink' is elided in the Aorist and for the vowel of the reduplicate there is substituted long ई।

7.4.5.v: Short इ is substituted for the penultimate vowel of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) स्था in the Aorist.

7.4.6.v: Short इ is optionally substituted for the penultimate vowel of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) of घ्रा in the Aorist.

7.4.7.v: Short ऋ is optionally substituted for the penultimate ऋ and ॠ of a Causative अङ्ग (stem) in the reduplicated Aorist.

7.4.8.v: Short ऋ is invariably substituted in the छन्दस् (Vedas) for the penultimate ऋ or ॠ of a Causative अङ्ग (stem) in the reduplicated Aorist.

7.4.9.v: दिगि is substituted for दे (दयते) in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.10.v: A root ending in short ऋ and preceded by a conjunct consonant gets गुण in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.11.v: There is गुण in the लिट् (Perfect Tense) of 1. ऋच्छ् 2. ॠ and roots ending in long ॠ।

7.4.12.v: In 1. शॄ 'to injure' 2. दॄ 'to tear' and 3. पॄ 'to protect'-- all belonging to क्र्यादिगणः (9th Conjugation), the vowel may be optionally shortened in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.13.v: Before the affix क the preceding आ , ई and ऊ are shortened.

7.4.14.v: But before the समासान्त affix कप् coming after बहुव्रीहि समास , the अण् vowels are not shortened.

7.4.15.v: Optionally the feminine अङ्ग (stem) in आ is not shortened before the affix कप्।

7.4.16.v: गुण is substituted for the vowel of the root before the affix अङ् in the roots ending in ऋ or ॠ as well as दृश् 'to see'.

7.4.17.v: The अङ्ग (stem) अस् 'to be' (अस्यते) gets the augment थुक् before this Aorist अङ्।

7.4.18.v: The अ is substituted for the final of श्वि in the Aorist अङ्।

7.4.19.v: The augment प् is added after the vowel of a root पत् 'to fall' in the Aorist अङ्।

7.4.20.v: The augment उ is added after the अ of वच् in the Aorist अङ्।

7.4.21.v: For the vowel of शी there is substituted गुण when a सार्वधातुक affix follows.

7.4.22.v: Before an affix beginning with a य् and having an indicatory क् or ङ् there is substituted अय् for the ई of शी।

7.4.23.v: The short is substituted for the ऊ of ऊह् when a preposition precedes it and an affix beginning with य् with an indicatory क् or ङ् follows.

7.4.24.v: The short is substituted for the vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) इ (एति) before the augment यास् in the Benedictive, when a preposition precedes it.

7.4.25.v: A long is substituted for the final vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) before an affix beginning with य् having an indicatory क् or ङ् , when it is not a कृत् or a सार्वधातुक affix.

7.4.26.v: A long is substituted for the final vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) before the Adverbial affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]].

7.4.27.v: री is substituted for the final short ऋ of a अङ्ग (stem) before an affix beginning with य् when it is not a कृत् or a सार्वधातुक affix and the Adverbial affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]].

7.4.28.v: For the final short ऋ of a root, there is substituted रि before the present character अ (श) before the Passive character य् and before the augment यास् in the Benedictive.
7.4.28.e: A ऋकारान्त-धातु get a रिङ्-आदेश in presence of  'श' प्रत्यय,  यक्-प्रत्यय and आशीर्लिङ् लकार.
7.4.28.sa: 'श' प्रत्यये परे,  'यक्' प्रत्यये परे, असार्वधातुके लिङ्-लकारे परे च ऋकारान्त-धातोः रिङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
7.4.28.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.29.v: गुण is substituted for the final ऋ in the root ऋ (अर्ति) and in those roots ending in ऋ in which the vowel is preceded by a conjunct consonant, when the Passive character यक् or the Benedictive augment यास् follows.

7.4.30.v: गुण is substituted for the final ऋ in those roots ending in ऋ in which the vowel is preceded by a conjunct consonant, when the Intensive character यङ् follows.

7.4.31.v: Long ई is substituted for the vowel of the roots 1. घ्रा and 2. ध्मा in the Intensive.

7.4.32.v: Long ई is substituted for the final of अ or आ of a Nominal stem, before the Adverbial affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]]।

7.4.33.v: Long ई is substituted for the final of अ or आ of a Nominal stem, before the Denominative affix क्यच् ।

7.4.34.v: The Denominative roots 1. अशनाय 2. उदन्य and 3. धनाय are irregularly formed when they respectively mean 1. 'to be hungry' 2. 'to be thirsty' and 3. 'to be greedy'.

7.4.35.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the above rules causing lengthening or the substitution of long ई for the final vowel of the अङ्ग (stem), do not apply, except in the case of पुत्र।

7.4.36.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) 1. दुरस्यु 2. द्रविणस्यु 3. वृषण्यति and 4. रिषण्यति are irregularly formed

7.4.37.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) long आ is substituted for the final of 1. अश्व and 2. अघ before the Denominative क्यच् ।

7.4.38.v: Long आ is substituted for the final of देव and सुम्न before the Denominative क्यच् in यजुष काठक।

7.4.39.v: In the ऋग् वेद the final of 1. कवि 2. अध्वर and 3. पृतना is dropped before the Denominative affix क्यच् ।

7.4.40.v: Short इ is substituted for the final of 1. दो 2. सो 3. मा and 4. स्था before an affix beginning with त् and having an indicatory क् ।

7.4.41.v: Short इ is optionally substituted for the final of 1. शा (शो) and 2. छा (छो) before an affix beginning with त् and having an indicatory क् ।

7.4.42.v: हि is optionally substituted for धा (दधाति) before an affix beginning with त् and having an indicatory क् ।

7.4.43.v: हि is optionally substituted for हा (जहाति) before क्त्वा।

7.4.44.v: हि is optionally substituted for हा (जहाति) before क्त्वा in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

7.4.45.v: These five Vedic forms are irregularly formed - 1. सुधित 2. वसुधित 3. नेमधित 4. धिष्व and 3. धिषीय।

7.4.46.v: For दा , when it is a घु - दाधा घ्वदाप् [[1.1.20]], there is substituted दद् before a कित् affix beginning with त् ।

7.4.47.v: त् is substituted for the घु - दाधा घ्वदाप् [[1.1.20]], before a कित् affix beginning with त when a preposition ending in a vowel preceded it.

7.4.48.v: त् is substituted for the final of the अङ्ग (stem) अप् before a case-ending beginning with भ्।

7.4.49.v: त् is substituted for the final स् of a root before an आर्द्धधातुक affix beginning with a स्।
7.4.49.e: A  सकारान्त अङ्ग gets a तकारादेश When followed by a सकारादि-आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय.
7.4.49.sa: सकारान्तस्य अङ्गस्य सकारादि-आर्धधातुके प्रत्यये परे तकारादेशः भवति ।
7.4.49.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.50.v: The final स् of तास् (the character of the second future) and अस् 'to be' is elided before an affix beginning with स् ।
7.4.50.e: The सकार of तास् प्रत्यय and the verb root  अस् is removed when followed by सकार.
7.4.50.sa: तास्-प्रत्ययस्य तथा अस्-धातोः सकारे परे लोपः भवति ।
7.4.50.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.51.v: The final स् of तास् (the character of the second future) and अस् 'to be' is elided before an affix beginning with र्।
7.4.51.e: The last letter (सकार) of the तास्-प्रत्यय is removed when followed by a रेफ.
7.4.51.sa: तास्-प्रत्ययस्य अन्तिमवर्णस्य रेफे परे लोपः भवति ।
7.4.51.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.52.v: The स् of तास् (the character of the second future) and अस् 'to be' is substituted ह् before the personal-ending ए।

7.4.53.v: The final of दीधी and वेवी falls before an affix beginning with य् , इ or ई।

7.4.54.v: इस् is substituted for the root-vowel of 1. मी 2. मा 3. धा (घु) 4. रभ् 5. लभ् 6. शक् 7. पत् 8. पद् and 9. दा when the Desiderative सन् follows beginning with स् (i.e. not taking the augment इ) follows.

7.4.55.v: For the vowel of the roots 1. आप् 2. ज्ञपि and 3. ऋध् there is substituted long ई before सन् of the Desiderative when it begins with स्।

7.4.56.v: For the vowel of the root दम्भ् there is substituted इ as well as ई before सन् of the Desiderative when it begins with स्।

7.4.57.v: When मुच् has an Intransitive signification गुण is optionally substituted for its vowel before the अनिट् सन् of the Desiderative.

7.4.58.v: The reduplicate is elided under the circumstances mentioned in the foregoing sūtras सनि मीमाघुरभलभशकपतपदामच इस् [[7.4.54]] to मुचोऽकर्मकस्य गुणो वा [[7.4.57]].

7.4.59.v: A short is substituted for the long vowel of the reduplicate.
7.4.59.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.60.v: Of the consonants of the reduplicate, only the first is retained, the remainders are elided.
7.4.60.e: Only the first  हल् letter from अभ्यास is retained, rest all  हल् letters are removed.
7.4.60.sa: अभ्यासस्य केवलं प्रथमस्थाने विद्यमानः हल्-वर्णः अवशिष्यते, अन्यानि हल्-वर्णानि लुप्यन्ते ।
7.4.60.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.61.v: Of a reduplicate, the hard compound (aspirate and un-aspirate) when preceded by a sibilant, are only retained, the other consonants are elided.
7.4.61.e: For an अभ्यास, all खय् letters that follows शर् letters are retained, all other हल् letters are removed.
7.4.61.sa: अभ्यासे यदि शर्-वर्णात् परः खय्-वर्णाः सन्ति तर्हि ते सर्वे अवशिष्यन्ते, अन्ये हल्-वर्णाः लुप्यन्ते ।
7.4.61.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.62.v: For the guttural and ह् of a reduplicate there is substituted a Platal.
7.4.62.e: The कवर्गीय letter and the हकार of an अभ्यास are converted to an appropriate चवर्गीय letter.
7.4.62.sa: अभ्यासस्य कवर्गीयवर्णस्य हकारस्य च चवर्गीयवर्णादेशः भवति ।
7.4.62.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.63.v: The Palatal is not substituted for the Guttural of the reduplicate of कु (कवते) in the intensive.

7.4.64.v: The Palatal is not substituted for the Guttural of the reduplicate of कृष् 'to draw' in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when in the Intensive.

7.4.65.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) are found the following eighteen irregularly reduplicated forms - 1. दाधर्ति 2. दर्धर्ति 3. दर्धर्षि 4. बोभूतु 5. तेतिक्ते 6. अलर्षि 7. आपनीफणत् 8. संसनिष्यदत् 9. करिक्रत् 10. कनिक्रदत् 11.भरिभ्रत् 12. द्दविध्वतः 13. दविद्युतत् 14. तरित्रतः 15. सरीसृपतम् 16. वरीवृजत् 17. मर्मृज्य and 18. आगनीगन्ति।

7.4.66.v: अर् -- उरण् रपरः [[1.1.51]] is substituted for the ऋ or ॠ of the reduplicate.
7.4.66.e: A ऋ  letter present in an अभ्यास is converted to  अकार.
7.4.66.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.67.v: There is vocalisation of the half-vowel of the reduplicate of द्युत् and स्वापि (Causative of स्वप्).

7.4.68.v: There is vocalisation of the half-vowel of the reduplicate of व्यथ् in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.69.v: A long vowel is substituted in the reduplicate of the root इ (एति) before a personal ending of the लिट् (Perfect Tense), which has an indicatory क्।

7.4.70.v: A long vowel is substituted in the लिट् (Perfect Tense) for the initial अ of the reduplicate.

7.4.71.v: After such a lengthened आ of the reduplicate there is added the augment नुट् (न्) to the short अ of the root which ends in a double consonant.

7.4.72.v: After the lengthened आ of the reduplicate of अश् (अश्नोति) comes the augment नुट् (न्) before the short अ in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.73.v: अ is substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate of भू 'to be' in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).
7.4.73.e: When followed by लिट्-लकार, the अभ्यास of the verb root भू is converted to अकार.
7.4.73.sa: लिट्-लकारे परे  भू-धातोः अभ्यासस्य अकारादेशः भवति ।
7.4.73.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.4.74.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) ससूव is irregularly formed in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.4.75.v: गुण is substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate in the Reduplicated Present form (श्लु) of निज् , विज् and विष्।

7.4.76.v: In the Reduplicated Present form (श्लु) of the three roots 1. भृ 2. मा (माङ्) and 3. हा (ओहाङ्), इ is substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate.

7.4.77.v: इ is substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate of ऋ and पृ in the reduplicated Present form.

7.4.78.v: इ is diversely substituted in the छन्दस् (Vedas) for the vowel of the reduplicate, in the Reduplicated Present-form.

7.4.79.v: इ is substituted for the final short अ of the reduplicate in the Desiderative.

7.4.80.v: इ is substituted for the final उ or ऊ of a reduplicate before a labial, a semi-vowel and before ज् when अ or आ follows these consonants, in the Desiderative.

7.4.81.v: इ is optionally substituted for the final उ of a reduplicate of 1. स्रु 2. श्रु 3. द्रु 4. प्रु 5. प्लु and 6. च्यु when the semi-vowel is followed by a अ or आ in the Desiderative.

7.4.82.v: गुण is substituted for the final of इ and उ (with their long) of a reduplicate when the Intensive character यङ् follows and also when it is elided.

7.4.83.v: A long vowel is substituted for the अ of the reduplicate in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्) when the reduplicate receives no augment having an indicatory क् ।

7.4.84.v: The augment नीक् is added to the reduplicate of the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्) in the following - 1. वञ्च् 2. संस्र 3. ध्वंस् 3. भ्रंश् 4. कस् 5. पत् 6. पद् and 7. स्कन्द्।

7.4.85.v: The augment नुक् (न्) is added after the short अ of a reduplicate in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्) when the root ends in a nasal.

7.4.86.v: The augment नुक् (न्) comes after the reduplicates of 1. जप 2. जभ 3. दह 4. दश 5. भञ्ज and 6. पश in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्).

7.4.87.v: The augment नुक् (न्) comes after the reduplicates of चर् and फल् in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्).

7.4.88.v: For the subsequent अ (i.e. for the अ of the root and not of the reduplicate), there is substituted उ in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्).

7.4.89.v: उ is substituted for the vowel of चर् and फल् before an affix beginning with त्।

7.4.90.v: The reduplicate of a root which has ऋ at the penultimate position, gets the augment री in the Intensive (with expressed or elided यङ्).

7.4.91.v: The augments come after the reduplicate of a root which has ऋ at the penultimate position, only when the यङ् of the Intensive is elided.

7.4.92.v: The reduplicate of a root which ends in short ऋ gets, in the Intensive without यङ् the above augments (1. रीक् 2. रुक् and 3. रिक्), 1. रि 2. र् and 3. रि।

7.4.93.v: In the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative, the reduplicate adapts itself to that of the Desiderative when the vowel of the root is light and the root has not lost its end-vowel before the Causative affix.

7.4.94.v: In the reduplicative syllable, a prosodially short vowel is lengthened in the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative when the vowel of the root is light and the root has not lost its end-vowel before the Causative णि।

7.4.95.v: Short अ is substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate in the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative of the roots 1. स्मृ 2. दॄ 3. त्वर 4. प्रथ 5. म्रद 6. स्तॄ and 7. स्पश्।

7.4.96.v: Short अ is optionally substituted for the vowel of the reduplicate in the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative of वेष्ट् and चेष्ट्।

7.4.97.v: In the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative, ई is substituted optionally for the vowel of the reduplicate in गण्।
